parameters.content:
## DEPLOYED — live in n8n since 2026-07-31
Modeled on BNS's Telegram Approval Listener pause/resume mechanism (read directly from beautifulnaturescenes-/beautiful_naturescenes_telegram_approval_listener_workflow.json to reuse the real shape, not invent a new one) plus architecture.md §6's Check-In Agent spec. This is the SENDER half — a companion listener workflow (Household_Ledger_CheckIn_Reply_Listener.json) runs 24/7 alongside this one.

SCHEMA EXTENSION: `Settings` carries two extra columns for the pause/resume mechanism: `CheckIn_Status` (idle/pending) and `CheckIn_ResumeURL`. Mirrors BNS's own Calendar.Status/ResumeURL columns, just on the single-row Settings tab instead of a per-day Calendar row, since there's only ever one household to check in on at a time. Live via `provision_sheet.py`.

IMPROVEMENT ON THE SOURCE PATTERN: BNS's own exported main workflow JSON doesn't actually include the node that captures `$execution.resumeUrl` and writes it to the sheet before the Wait node fires — that connective step is missing even in their template. This scaffold adds it explicitly ('Store Resume URL + Pending State' below) rather than silently copying the same gap forward.

STATUS: real `documentId`, chat ID, Google Sheets credential, and Telegram bot credential all wired; workflow published. Open Decision #4 (cadence) resolved 2026-08-01 — every 3 days. Not yet live-tested end-to-end.

Auto-add-to-list step does a Catalog lookup for the cheapest store, same logic as the app's own bestStore() function in src/App.jsx — kept in sync manually for now; a future version could extract that into a shared function.

nodes.name: Check-In Trigger (every 3 days)
nodes.notes: Open Decision #4 resolved 2026-08-01: every 3 days, chosen over the 2-day default and daily.

nodes.name: Store Resume URL + Pending State
nodes.notes: Must run BEFORE the Wait node below — captures the resume URL while it's still available in this execution's context, per n8n's documented pattern for externally-triggered resume. Uses the proposed Settings schema extension.

nodes.name: Wait for Check-In Reply
nodes.notes: Resumes when Household_Ledger_CheckIn_Reply_Listener.json calls this execution's resume URL. Times out after 48h if no reply — falls through with no lowItems/finishedItems, handled gracefully by the next Code node. httpMethod must be POST to match Call Resume Webhook's POST call (it needs a body for lowItems/finishedItems) — left unset originally, which silently defaulted to GET and caused every resume attempt to 404 with 'no waiting webhook with a matching path/method' (found live 2026-08-08).

operation must be appendOrUpdate, not update -- Inventory starts with zero rows, so any item reported via check-in for the first time has no existing row to 'update' and update silently does nothing. Found live 2026-08-01 when a real FINISHED/LOW reply produced no visible change in the Sheet.
nodes.name: Update Inventory Rows
Merge Both Branches
nodes.notes: Same join pattern as the existing Webhook Agent's 'Merge List + Settings' node — waits for both the Inventory-update branch and the auto-add branch to finish before confirming, rather than firing twice.

parameters.text: =✅ Inventory updated. Low/finished items auto-added to the list where a price was on file.
